_doc: Config of the device add-ons state-stability (CR-83), safe-area (CR-85) and action-outcome (CR-86) wait-fallback (CR-87) and peek-visible (CR-01). Loosen per element with a reason and the user decision; never globally. Registered in tools/consistency-check.mjs after HANDOFF.md has the section Capture tool, final, 2026-11-09.

siblingActions._doc: K23 / CR-91 (user 2026-11-10, Apri il link): stacked actions share width or both edges; 2+ actions use at least half of the content width unless something else is drawn beside them. tolDp 1 like the other geometry rules; minShare 0.5: the user's case was 16% (fold) and 31% (cover), the approved paste page has no stacked group.

confirmRight._doc: K30 / CR-96 (user 2026-11-10 22:40: tasto conferma sta a destra). Roles by testTag/resource-id: the confirming or forward action is tagged action-confirm*, secondary and escape actions action-secondary*; the confirm one is the rightmost of its row. Never by label text.

workInProgress._doc: K18 / CR-86 (user 2026-11-10 13:18 and 14:05): work shows in the control that owns it; the in-button loader is tagged progress_primary (the app used eb_paste_outcome / a page line before, which this list did not accept). Flags: no progress, disabled primary with its idle label while progress sits elsewhere, two progress nodes. Pair check (workPair) is not wired into consistency-check yet.

keyboardReturn._doc: K22 / CR-90 (user 2026-11-10): the capture tool does not yet write <screen>-kbd-fNN frame sequences with the keyboard height; fed by fixtures until it does.

peekVisible._doc: CR-01, every period strip on every screen (the hero tile, and the cards of Mese, Spese, Contributions: the shared card shell and PeriodSwipe tag the page surface), the neighbour slot must hold a drawn tile at least the peek wide (40 dp open Fold, 28 dp cover). dir: real captures and the CR-01 peek-no-surface fixtures only; older fixtures predate the surface tag.

G-11 range ends (CR-89, user 2026-11-10: "Qua perché così stretto?", "va bene modifica schermata"): on a side where no neighbour page is drawn the current page surface must reach the content margin = viewport edge -/+ endGutterDp (PageSpec.Gutter, the caller gutter the strip overhangs by), within endTolDp; both sides empty = a single page, margin to margin. Real captures and the CR-89 fixtures only.

actionGroups._doc: K26 / CR-94 (user 2026-11-10: apri gmail e incolla link sono opzioni della stessa cosa; non si puo piu cambiare email). groups: [{ screen, groups: [{ name, members: [tags] }] }] declared for the wait page only after the user approves its concept (board output/concepts/eb-wait-2026-11-10b.png); removedByUser: [{ screen, tag, quote }] (the quote is the user's words, required). removed-action runs only with --baseline <dir>.

capture.states: tap every checkable/selectable node, dump before and after
capture.actions: tap every action control listed in actionOutcome.actions, dump after settle
capture.insets: record dump.insets (dp) from dumpsys window or the in-app root WindowInsets
capture.launch: frames from process start (am start then screencap/dump every 150 ms for 3 s)
